description_en: Designed for efficiently detecting and recognizing printed English characters in fully English image-based documents, this solution provides English-specific recognition and English tokenization features, and supports basic functionalities such as rotation handling, table detection, and text coordinate extraction
description_zh: 针对全英文图片文档场景下英文印刷体字符高效检测和识别，具备英文专项识别和英文分词功能，支持旋转、表格、文字坐标等多项基础功能
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api recognize-english --url https://help-static-aliyun-doc.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20241218/lvwnly/%E8%8B%B1%E8%AF%AD%E4%BD%9C%E6%96%87%E8%AF%86%E5%88%AB.png --biz-body '图片二进制文件' --need-rotate false --output-table false --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeEnglish

parameters.description_en:

* Binary file of the image, up to 10 MB in size.  
* When invoking via HTTP, upload the binary image file in the HTTP body.  
* When using the software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK body.
